title: The Alibi of Little Hawley
author: Y. M. Crane
blurb: Oscar Hartwell, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
